title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations in Uptown Normal’s campus-adjacent blocks, each paired with one sourced reason to follow its corridor.

cards.title: Use the Library’s Public Tech
cards.subtitle: College Avenue — computers, Wi-Fi, and document services
cards.notes: Follow College Avenue to use a public computer or Wi-Fi; printing, copying, and faxing are also available on site.
cards.short_summary: A practical College Avenue stop for public connectivity and document tasks.
cards.evidence_claim: Normal Public Library is at 206 W. College Avenue and provides computers, laptops, Wi-Fi, printing, faxing, and copying services.
cards.access_notes: Main Branch access and current services are listed on the library’s official visit page.

cards.title: Start with an Early Café Stop
cards.subtitle: North Street — coffee and bakery items from 6:30 a.m.
cards.notes: Walk North Street for an early café option; check the official location page before relying on its posted daily schedule.
cards.short_summary: An independently documented café address on the campus-facing end of North Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Coffee Hound’s Uptown Normal café is at 205 W. North Street and serves drinks and bakery items, with daily hours beginning at 6:30 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The business currently posts daily hours of 6:30 a.m.–4 p.m.; confirm before visiting.

cards.title: See the Restored Uptown Cinema
cards.subtitle: North Street — scheduled films and live shows
cards.notes: Continue east on North Street for the theater marquee, then consult the official calendar and buy tickets for a scheduled program.
cards.short_summary: A named historic cinema gives this North Street block a clear visual landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: Normal Theater is located at 209 North Street in historic Uptown Normal, with walk-up and online ticket sales for its programming.
cards.source_title: Contact | Normal Theater, IL - Official Website
cards.access_notes: The box office opens 30 minutes before showtime; consult the theater calendar for current programs.

cards.title: Pause at the Beaufort Café
cards.subtitle: Beaufort Street — café service seven days a week
cards.notes: Use Beaufort Street for a daytime café break; verify the posted schedule and place an order by phone if timing is tight.
cards.short_summary: A long-running café storefront anchors the eastern approach to Uptown Circle.
cards.evidence_claim: The Coffeehouse & Deli is located at 114 E. Beaufort Street and lists café hours seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: The business currently lists Monday–Sunday hours of 7 a.m.–6 p.m.; confirm before visiting.

cards.title: Find Three Floors of Hands-On Exhibits
cards.subtitle: Beaufort Street — an interactive museum in Uptown
cards.notes: Follow Beaufort Street to the museum’s distinctive entrance; review admission and exhibit details before planning an indoor visit.
cards.short_summary: A highly photographable museum facade and interactive exhibits define this Beaufort block.
cards.evidence_claim: Children’s Discovery Museum is at 101 E. Beaufort Street in Uptown Normal and offers three floors of hands-on exhibits.
cards.access_notes: Admission is generally required; check the museum’s official hours and ticket information before entering.

cards.title: Order Sicilian-Style Pizza
cards.subtitle: Beaufort Street — dine-in or takeout beside the museum
cards.notes: Continue along Beaufort Street for Sicilian-style pizza; use the direct menu for current choices and ordering details.
cards.short_summary: A named pizza storefront adds a food stop beside the museum and station.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Payaa Uptown is at 107 E. Beaufort Street and offers Sicilian-style pizza for dine-in, takeout, or delivery.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists daily service, but visitors should confirm current hours before ordering.

cards.entity_name: University Galleries of Illinois State University
cards.title: See the Current University Exhibition
cards.subtitle: Uptown Circle — free contemporary art exhibitions
cards.notes: Enter from Uptown Circle and check the exhibition calendar first; admission to gallery exhibitions and events is free.
cards.short_summary: ISU’s public contemporary-art venue extends campus culture into Uptown Station.
cards.evidence_claim: University Galleries is located at 11 Uptown Circle, Suite 103, and all exhibitions and events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Visit the Galleries | University Galleries | Illinois State
cards.access_notes: Use the gallery’s official visit page for current seasonal hours; exhibitions and events are free and public.

cards.title: Connect to Rail and Local Transit
cards.subtitle: Uptown Circle — Normal’s multimodal transportation hub
cards.notes: Approach from Uptown Circle to connect with rail or bus service; verify tickets and departure times with the relevant carrier.
cards.short_summary: The station makes this block the district’s principal transportation connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Uptown Station at 11 Uptown Circle is a multimodal hub connecting rail, intercity and local buses, airport shuttles, taxis, cars, and pedestrians.
cards.source_title: Uptown Station | Normal, IL - Official Website
cards.access_notes: The first-floor station currently lists daily operations from 6:30 a.m.–9:30 p.m.; carrier schedules vary.

cards.title: Step into the Circle Minipark
cards.subtitle: Uptown Circle — a public space inside the roundabout
cards.notes: Use marked crossings to reach the minipark, then pause among its shade trees and water feature without entering the roadway.
cards.short_summary: A designed public minipark turns the district’s roundabout into a recognizable destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Uptown Circle contains a public gathering space with mature shade trees and a flowing water feature inside the roundabout linking Beaufort, North, and Constitution.
cards.access_notes: Reach the minipark only by designated pedestrian crossings and follow posted traffic controls.

cards.title: Join the Paved Recreation Trail
cards.subtitle: Constitution Boulevard — walk or bike through Uptown
cards.notes: Join the paved trail near Uptown, keep right, and review current rules before walking, jogging, or riding beyond the district.
cards.short_summary: A converted rail corridor provides a car-free route extending beyond Uptown’s blocks.
cards.evidence_claim: Constitution Trail is a former railway converted into a paved recreational trail used for walking, hiking, biking, and jogging through Normal and Bloomington.
cards.source_title: Biking Trails | Normal, IL - Official Website
cards.access_notes: Open from one hour before sunrise until one hour after sunset; follow posted trail rules and device restrictions.
